title: "6. Romito墓葬与史前罕见遗传病"
subtitle: "Romito burial and a rare prehistoric genetic disorder"
---

## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** Romito 2自1960年代发现以来一直是古病理学与“照护生物考古学”的经典案例：一名明显矮小、肢体比例异常的年轻个体被另一名成年个体环抱安葬。过去研究只能依靠骨骼形态讨论其疾病、性别与社会照护。古DNA使这一案例进入“分子古病理学”阶段，可以把形态诊断、亲缘关系和具体致病基因放在同一证据框架中。

**English.** Romito 2 has long been a classic case in palaeopathology and the bioarchaeology of care because a markedly short-statured young individual was buried in an embrace with another adult. Earlier interpretations depended on skeletal morphology for diagnosis, sex, and social-care arguments. Ancient DNA now moves the case into molecular palaeopathology by linking morphology, kinship, and a specific pathogenic genotype.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 研究从两具著名Romito个体的岩部骨提取古DNA，确认两人均为女性且为一级亲属（很可能是母女，但不能视为定论），并通过NPR2基因变异解释两人的身高与骨骼发育异常。

**English.** Ancient DNA from the petrous bones of the two well-known Romito individuals established that both were female and first-degree relatives (probably mother and daughter, but not demonstrably so) and linked their skeletal growth abnormalities to variants in NPR2.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 这项工作标志着古基因组学从宏观人口史进一步进入个体生命史、亲属关系和古病理诊断。它展示了骨骼形态、古DNA与现代临床遗传学如何共同重建具体史前个体的疾病经历。

**English.** The study exemplifies a shift from population history toward individual life histories, kinship, and molecular palaeopathology. It shows how skeletal morphology, ancient DNA, and modern clinical genetics can be integrated to diagnose disease in specific prehistoric individuals.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

Fernandes, D. M., Llanos-Lizcano, A., Brück, F., Oberreiter, V., Özdoğan, K. T., Cheronet, O., Lucci, M., Beckers, A., Pétrossians, P., Coppa, A., Pinhasi, R., & Daly, A. F. (2026). A 12,000-Year-Old Case of <i>NPR2</i> -Related Acromesomelic Dysplasia. New England Journal of Medicine, 394(5), 513–515. https://doi.org/10.1056/nejmc2513616

**开放获取状态 | Open-access status.** 可免费阅读，但不是Creative Commons许可；再利用需遵循NEJM权限政策。 / Free to read, but not Creative Commons licensed; reuse follows NEJM permissions.

**出版物内容（中文）。** 这篇通讯利用古DNA确定 Romito 1 与 Romito 2 均为女性且为一级亲属，并在 NPR2 基因中识别出与 Maroteaux 型肢端肢中发育不全相符的变异。文章把一个长期依赖骨骼形态推断的经典古病理案例推进到分子临床诊断层面，同时为史前残障个体的照护讨论增加直接证据。

**What the publication shows (English).** This report uses ancient DNA to show that Romito 1 and Romito 2 were both female first-degree relatives and identifies NPR2 variants consistent with Maroteaux-type acromesomelic dysplasia. It moves a classic palaeopathological case from morphology-based inference to molecular clinical diagnosis and strengthens discussion of care for disabled individuals in prehistory.
